description: This file contains a partial implementation of the mbstring extension functionalities in PHP, providing multibyte string handling features such as encoding conversion, case conversion, substring manipulation, and encoding detection, encapsulated within the final class Mbstring under the Symfony\Polyfill\Mbstring namespace.

classes.name: Mbstring
classes.description: A PHP class providing an implementation of multibyte string functions, including encoding conversion, case conversion, substring extraction, and detection, to emulate the mbstring extension functionality.

methods.name: mb_convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts a string or an array of strings from one encoding to another, handling base64 and HTML entities as special cases.

methods.name: mb_convert_variables
methods.description: Recursively converts multiple variables from one encoding to another.

methods.name: mb_decode_mimeheader
methods.description: Decodes a MIME header field.

methods.name: mb_encode_mimeheader
methods.description: Encodes a string to be used in MIME headers (not implemented, triggers a warning).

methods.name: mb_decode_numericentity
methods.description: Decodes HTML numeric entities to their UTF-8 representation.

methods.name: mb_encode_numericentity
methods.description: Encodes characters into HTML numeric entities.

methods.name: mb_convert_case
methods.description: Performs case folding (to upper, lower, or title case) on a string.

methods.name: mb_internal_encoding
methods.description: Gets or sets the internal character encoding.

methods.name: mb_language
methods.description: Gets or sets the language setting.

methods.name: mb_list_encodings
methods.description: Returns an array of supported encodings.

methods.name: mb_encoding_aliases
methods.description: Provides aliases for specific encodings, e.g., UTF-8.

methods.name: mb_check_encoding
methods.description: Checks if the string is valid for a given encoding or set of encodings.

methods.name: mb_detect_encoding
methods.description: Detects the encoding of a string from a list or supports strict detection.

methods.name: mb_detect_order
methods.description: Sets or gets the preferred order of encodings.

methods.name: mb_strlen
methods.description: Returns the length of a string in characters for multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_strpos
methods.description: Finds position of first occurrence of a string within another, supporting multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_strrpos
methods.description: Finds position of last occurrence of a string within another.

methods.name: mb_str_split
methods.description: Splits a string into an array of strings with specified length.

methods.name: mb_strtolower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase, multibyte aware.

methods.name: mb_strtoupper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase, multibyte aware.

methods.name: mb_substitute_character
methods.description: Gets or sets the substitute character used when invalid characters are encountered.

methods.name: mb_substr
methods.description: Returns part of a string, supporting multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_stripos
methods.description: Finds position of first occurrence of a case-insensitive string.

methods.name: mb_stristr
methods.description: Finds first occurrence of a string in another (case-insensitive), returning part of string.

methods.name: mb_strrchr
methods.description: Finds last occurrence of a character in a string.

methods.name: mb_strrichr
methods.description: Finds last occurrence of a character in a string (case-insensitive).

methods.name: mb_strripos
methods.description: Finds position of the last occurrence of a case-insensitive string.

methods.name: mb_strstr
methods.description: Finds first occurrence of a string.

methods.name: mb_get_info
methods.description: Returns information about the current mbstring settings.

methods.name: mb_http_input
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP input encoding (stub: always returns false).

methods.name: mb_http_output
methods.description: Sets or gets HTTP output encoding.

methods.name: mb_strwidth
methods.description: Returns display width of a string.

methods.name: mb_substr_count
methods.description: Counts the number of occurrences of a substring within a string.

methods.name: mb_output_handler
methods.description: Handles output buffer conversion.

methods.name: mb_chr
methods.description: Creates a character from a Unicode code point.

methods.name: mb_ord
methods.description: Returns the Unicode code point of a character.

methods.name: mb_str_pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a certain length with another string, supporting multibyte encodings.

methods.name: mb_ucfirst
methods.description: Capitalizes the first character of a string.

methods.name: mb_lcfirst
methods.description: Lowercases the first character of a string.

methods.name: mb_trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace or other characters from both ends of a string.

methods.name: mb_ltrim
methods.description: Removes characters from the beginning of a string.

methods.name: mb_rtrim
methods.description: Removes characters from the end of a string.
